main_text.head: IOANNIS DALLÆI DE FIDEI EX SCRIPTVRIS DEMONSTRATIONE, Aduersus nouam quorundam Methodum, DISPVTATIO.
PARS PRIMA.
CAPVT I.
Operis PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: VPER exorti sunt nouiriį Doctores, qui nostrarum Ecclesiarum fidem negant ex Dei Scripturis, quas nos tamen solas in religione duces, magistrasqį sequendas contendimus, demonstrari posse. Placuit aduersariis mustea cauillatio; in qua nunc vna plærique vulgo omnem suâ sophisticen, atqį dialecticen ita collocarunt, vt putent ad nos debellandos hoc vnum satis esse, si diserta de singulis fidei nostræ capitibus Scripturæ loca flagitentur; neque dubitent, quin de nobis nullo negotio sit triumphaturus.

page.notes: The woodcut initial N is joined to "UPER" as "VPER"; reading of "nouiriį" and "mustea" is uncertain; the catchword "quiŧ" at the foot right is partly illegible and marked as a catchword candidate. Printed "quil" read as "quiŧ" with [?] advised.
